title: Collision-hotspots explainer for >= 1 area (STATS19, aggregate-only)
context: STATS19 (UK DfT) contains casualty-level road collision records (age band, sex, severity, location). Aggregate hotspot views can help journalists and community groups understand road safety — but person-level rows must never appear in output, geographic/temporal bins with fewer than k=5 events must not be shown (re-identification risk), and no bin or road may be labelled as 'dangerous' (causation/harm risk). A mandatory harm scan and domain review are required.
objective: Build a collision-hotspots explainer for at least one area (STATS19 data, aggregate-only, k>=5 minimum cell count) passing gate-003, the methodology gate, the PII/aggregation gate, and a harm scan.
acceptanceCriteria: Gate-003 PASS: STATS19 OGL v3; output text CC-BY-4.0 with OGL attribution ('Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0'); aggregate-only output; k >= 5 minimum cell count per geo/temporal bin; geo-precision limit applied; no person-level rows in any output; no re-identification possible.
Methodology Card: appropriate denominators and exposure metrics used where relevant; noise acknowledged; no causation and no 'dangerous road' labelling; explicit 'not advice / non-partisan' notice.
Harm scan passed (no blame/stigma/community targeting); Domain (road-safety) + Methodology+Stats + Accessibility reviewer sign-offs obtained.
Figures reproduce in CI from committed code + STATS19 snapshot; built on the shared toolkit (toolkit-002).
resources: PLAN.md — Data, licensing & compliance (STATS19/OGL row and Privacy/PII stance)
REGION-RUBRIC.md — Region-selection rubric and harm-scan checklist (prerequisite for region selection)
output: A collision-hotspots explainer for at least one area (committed static tool + plain-language content + Methodology Card + gate artifact + harm-scan record + accessibility sign-off).
